command:
set -eu
account=$(sed -n '1{s/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*//;p;}' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
password=[REDACTED] -n '2{s/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*//;p;}' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
[ "$account" = editor ]
[ -n "$password" ]
htpasswd -bc /etc/httpd/webdav.passwd "$account" "$password" >/dev/null
chown root:apache /etc/httpd/webdav.passwd
chmod 640 /etc/httpd/webdav.passwd
install -d -o apache -g apache -m 700 /var/lib/dav/lockdb
chown -R apache:apache /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents
find /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents -type d -exec chmod 2770 {} \;
find /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents -type f -exec chmod 660 {} \;

cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/webdav-documents.conf <<'ANTRIEB_WEBDAV_CONF'
DavLockDB /var/lib/dav/lockdb/DavLock
Alias /documents/ "/srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents/"

<Directory "/srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents">
    DAV On
    Options Indexes
    AuthType Basic
    AuthName "Project documents"
    AuthUserFile /etc/httpd/webdav.passwd
    Require valid-user
</Directory>
ANTRIEB_WEBDAV_CONF
printf 'configured_account=%s credential_file_mode=%s\n' "$account" "$(stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/httpd/webdav.passwd)"
